explanation: The Sun is about 150 million km away, so its light takes about 8 minutes 20 seconds to arrive. We always see the Sun as it was a few minutes earlier.

claims.text: Light from the Sun takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth.
Sunlight takes much longer than 8 seconds, and much less than 8 hours or 8 days, to reach Earth.
The Sun's average distance from Earth is about 150 million km.
Over that distance, light takes about 8 minutes 20 seconds to travel from the Sun to Earth.
Because its light takes time to arrive, we see the Sun as it was a few minutes before.
